name: devteam-hud
description: DevTeam HUD: team panel, plan-approval and blocker row, visible quality gates and guardrail, cost in the status line, /devteam-status, optional DevTeam look.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the panel, the row above the prompt and the cards.

autoOpen.title: Open the panel when a team starts
autoOpen.description: Open the DevTeam panel as soon as teammates appear (only where it docks as a sidebar).

costWarnAt.title: Warn above this many active teammates
costWarnAt.description: The status line shows a warning, and a toast appears once, above this number.

theme.title: DevTeam look
theme.description: Paint the desktop and mobile apps with the DevTeam colors. The terminal keeps its own.
